courseDescription: An introductory course helping parents and caregivers understand how harm impacts children and how positive change can support safety and wellbeing.

lessons.title: What is Harm?
lessons.definition: Harm is any action, behaviour or omission that negatively affects a child's wellbeing, safety, development or relationships.

lessons.title: Types of Harm
lessons.definition: Children may experience emotional, psychological, physical, developmental and relational harm.

lessons.title: Understanding Child Impact
lessons.definition: Harm affects brain development, trust, emotional regulation and relationships.

lessons.title: Recognising Responsibility
lessons.definition: Accountability means understanding the impact of actions and taking responsibility for change.

lessons.title: Repair and Recovery
lessons.definition: Repair focuses on rebuilding safety, trust and healthy relationships.

aiFacilitator.name: SafeSteps Learning Coach
welcomeMessage: This course will help you understand how behaviours affect children and how positive change can improve outcomes.
Learning is focused on reflection, growth and safer parenting practices.
